SupportAddedColdDamage.name: Added Cold Damage
SupportAddedColdDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAwakenedAddedColdDamage.name: Awakened Added Cold Damage
SupportAwakenedAddedColdDamage.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportArrowNova.name: Arrow Nova
SupportArrowNova.description: Supports bow attack skills that fire arrows forwards as projectiles. These skills will instead fire a payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. The supported skills' arrows will then fire out in a circle from where it lands. Cannot support skills that already fire arrows into the air, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.

SupportAwakenedArrowNova.name: Awakened Arrow Nova
SupportAwakenedArrowNova.description: Supports bow attack skills that fire arrows forwards as projectiles. These skills will instead fire a payload arrow into the air to land at a targeted location. The supported skills' arrows will then fire out in a circle from where it lands. Cannot support skills that already fire arrows into the air, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.

SupportBarrage.name: Barrage Support
SupportBarrage.description: Supports projectile attack skills that use bows or wands. Cannot support triggered skills, channelled skills, or skills that create Minions.

SupportBlind.name: Blind
SupportBlind.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportBlockChanceReduction.name: Block Chance Reduction
SupportBlockChanceReduction.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportCastOnCriticalStrike.name: Cast On Critical Strike
SupportCastOnCriticalStrike.description: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastOnCritTriggered.name: Cast On Critical Strike
SupportCastOnCritTriggered.description: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportAwakenedCastOnCriticalStrike.name: Awakened Cast On Critical Strike
SupportAwakenedCastOnCriticalStrike.description: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastOnCritTriggeredPlus.name: Awakened Cast On Critical Strike
SupportCastOnCritTriggeredPlus.description: Must support both an attack skill and a spell skill to work. The attack skill will trigger a spell when it critically strikes an enemy. Cannot support totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportCastOnDeath.name: Cast on Death
SupportCastOnDeath.description: Each supported spell skill will be triggered when you die. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines. Vaal skills, channelling skills, and skills with a reservation cannot be triggered.

SupportChain.name: Chain
SupportChain.description: Supports projectile skills, and any other skills that chain.

SupportAwakenedChain.name: Awakened Chain
SupportAwakenedChain.description: Supports projectile skills, and any other skills that chain.

SupportChanceToFlee.name: Chance to Flee
SupportChanceToFlee.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportCloseCombat.name: Close Combat
SupportCloseCombat.description: Supports melee attack skills. Cannot support skills which create minions.

support_slashing_damage_+%_final_from_di: mod("Damage", "MORE", nil, bit.bor(ModFlag.Attack, ModFlag.Melee), 0, { type = "MeleeProximity", ramp = {1,0} })
support_slashing_buff_attack_speed_+%_fi: mod("Speed", "MORE", nil, 0, 0, { type = "GlobalEffect", effectType = "Buff", effectName = "Combat Rush", effectCond = "CombatRushActive" }, { type = "Condition", var = "SupportedByCloseCombat", neg = true }, { type = "SkillType", skillType = SkillType.Travel })
close_combat_damage_to_close_range_+%: mod("Damage", "INC", nil, bit.bor(ModFlag.Attack, ModFlag.Melee), 0, { type = "Condition", var = "AtCloseRange" })

SupportClusterTraps.name: Cluster Traps
SupportClusterTraps.description: Supports traps skills, making them throw extra traps randomly around the targeted location.

SupportColdPenetration.name: Cold Penetration
SupportColdPenetration.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy cold resistance.

SupportAwakenedColdPenetration.name: Awakened Cold Penetration
SupportAwakenedColdPenetration.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies, making those hits penetrate enemy cold resistance.

SupportCullingStrike.name: Culling Strike
SupportCullingStrike.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies. If enemies are left below 10% of maximum life after being hit by these skills, they will be killed.

SupportDeadlyAilments.name: Deadly Ailments
SupportDeadlyAilments.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportAwakenedDeadlyAilments.name: Awakened Deadly Ailments
SupportAwakenedDeadlyAilments.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportEnhance.name: Enhance
SupportEnhance.description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the quality of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

SupportAwakenedEnhance.name: Awakened Enhance
SupportAwakenedEnhance.description: Supports any skill gem. Once this gem reaches level 2 or above, will raise the quality of supported gems. Cannot support skills that don't come from gems.

SupportFocusedBallista.name: Focused Ballista
SupportFocusedBallista.description: Supports skills that summon ballista totems. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportFork.name: Fork
SupportFork.description: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first time they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.

SupportAwakenedFork.name: Awakened Fork
SupportAwakenedFork.description: Supports projectile skills, making their projectiles fork into two projectiles the first two times they hit an enemy and don't pierce it.

SupportGreaterVolley.name: Greater Volley
SupportGreaterVolley.description: Supports skills that fire projectiles from the user. Does not affect projectiles fired from other locations as secondary effects. Does not support skills that fire projectiles in a spiral.

SupportHypothermia.name: Hypothermia
SupportHypothermia.description: Supports any skill that deals damage.

support_hypothermia_damage_+%_vs_chilled: mod("Damage", "MORE", nil, 0, bit.bor(KeywordFlag.Hit, KeywordFlag.Ailment), { type = "ActorCondition", actor = "enemy", var = "Chilled" })

SupportIceBite.name: Ice Bite
SupportIceBite.description: Supports any skill you use to hit enemies yourself. Cannot support skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

SupportLocusMine.name: Locus Mine
SupportLocusMine.description: Supports attack skills that use bows or wands and fire projectiles ahead. Instead of using that skill, you will throw mines that will use the skill for you when you detonate them, targeting your location. Mines cannot use channelling skills.

SupportChanceToPoison.name: Chance to Poison
SupportChanceToPoison.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportManaLeech.name: Mana Leech
SupportManaLeech.description: Supports attack skills that hit enemies, causing those hits to leech mana based on damage dealt.

SupportManaforgedArrows.name: Manaforged Arrows
SupportManaforgedArrows.description: Supports bow attack skills, causing them to trigger when you've spent enough mana in total on other bow attacks. Cannot modify the skills of minions. Cannot support totems, traps, mines, Vaal skills, or channelling skills

SupportMirageArcher.name: Mirage Archer
SupportMirageArcher.description: Supports attack skills that can be used with bows. Supported skills can only be used with bows. Cannot support Vaal skills, minion skills, movement skills, or skills used by totems, traps, or mines.

SupportMomentum.name: Momentum
SupportMomentum.description: Supports attack skills that aren't triggered.

support_momentum_movement_speed_+%_per_s: mod("MovementSpeed", "INC", nil, 0, 0, { type = "Multiplier", var = "MomentumStacksRemoved" }, { type = "GlobalEffect", effectType = "Buff" })

SupportMultipleTraps.name: Multiple Traps
SupportMultipleTraps.description: Supports traps skills, making them throw extra traps in a line.

SupportNightblade.name: Nightblade
SupportNightblade.description: Supports attack skills. Cannot support skills which create minions.

SupportCriticalStrikeAffliction.name: Critical Strike Affliction
SupportCriticalStrikeAffliction.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

support_rupture_bleeding_damage_taken_+%: mod("DamageTaken", "MORE", nil, 0, KeywordFlag.Bleed, { type = "GlobalEffect", effectType = "Debuff", effectName = "Rupture" }, { type = "Multiplier", var = "RuptureStack", limit = 4 })
support_rupture_bleeding_time_passed_+%_: mod("BleedExpireRate", "MORE", nil, 0, KeywordFlag.Bleed, { type = "GlobalEffect", effectType = "Debuff", effectName = "Rupture" }, { type = "Multiplier", var = "RuptureStack", limit = 4 })

SupportSadism.name: Sadism
SupportSadism.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

SupportSecondWind.name: Second Wind
SupportSecondWind.description:
Supports skills with cooldowns.
Cannot support triggered skills.

SupportSwiftAffliction.name: Swift Affliction
SupportSwiftAffliction.description: Supports any skill that has a duration, or can hit enemies to inflict ailments on them.

SupportAwakenedSwiftAffliction.name: Awakened Swift Affliction
SupportAwakenedSwiftAffliction.description: Supports any skill that has a duration, or can hit enemies to inflict ailments on them.

SupportSwiftAssembly.name: Swift Assembly
SupportSwiftAssembly.description: Supports skills which throw Traps or Mines.

SupportTrap.name: Trap
SupportTrap.description: Supports spells, or attacks that use bows or wands. Instead of using that skill, you will throw a trap that will use the skill for you when an enemy walks near it. Traps cannot use channelling skills.

SupportTrapAndMineDamage.name: Trap and Mine Damage
SupportTrapAndMineDamage.description: Supports skills which throw Traps or Mines.

SupportVileToxins.name: Vile Toxins
SupportVileToxins.description: Supports any skill that hits enemies.

support_debilitate_hit_damage_+%_final_p: mod("Damage", "MORE", nil, ModFlag.Hit, 0, { type = "Multiplier", actor = "enemy", var = "PoisonStack", limitVar = "VileToxinsPoisonLimit" })

SupportVoidManipulation.name: Void Manipulation
SupportVoidManipulation.description: Supports any skill that deals damage.

SupportAwakenedVoidManipulation.name: Awakened Void Manipulation
SupportAwakenedVoidManipulation.description: Supports any skill that deals damage.

SupportVolley.name: Volley
SupportVolley.description: Supports skills that fire projectiles from the user. Does not affect projectiles fired from other locations as secondary effects. Does not support skills that fire projectiles in a spiral.

SupportWindburst.name: Windburst
SupportWindburst.description: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to trigger Windburst on hit after you've travelled a certain distance. Cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

TriggeredSupportWindburst.name: Windburst
TriggeredSupportWindburst.description: Fires projectiles that move randomly and damage enemies they pierce through. They explode after a duration, dealing area damage.
